rationale: Quinbrook and Rowan identify Rowan Digital Infrastructure as the manager-level company and Temple as a subordinate 300 MW campus/SPV. Texas records identify Rowan Temple LLC as owner/operator and Polmer as occupant. The standalone Temple record should merge into Rowan, but UPP's post-April-2026 platform ownership remains unresolved.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Rowan Temple PortCo record into Rowan Digital Infrastructure.
Preserve Rowan Temple, Project Temple, Temple I, Temple Data Center and Rowan Temple LLC as subordinate project/SPV identities.
Preserve the approximately 700-acre, 300 MW, under-construction campus and 2027 target.
Keep broader Temple-region pipeline figures and the distinct Moriah and Stampede assets separate.
Exclude Polmer, Oncor, lenders, land parties, governments and contractors from equity ownership.
Resolve UPP's post-recapitalization Rowan position before applying the merge or changing Rowan ownership.
unresolvedQuestions: UPP's ownership status after the April 9, 2026 Blackstone recapitalization remains unresolved.
Exact Rowan and Temple ownership percentages, governance and holding vehicles are not publicly disclosed.
The exact Blackstone stake, lenders, land sellers and Polmer ultimate parent are not publicly disclosed.
fieldCorrections: Do not mark UPP definitively active after the Blackstone recap without explicit later evidence.
Do not conflate the current 300 MW Temple project with older 800 MW or broader 1.6 GW Temple-region pipeline references.
Do not treat customer, utility or debt relationships as equity.
